gloss: to drink up; to drink it all

definitions.gloss: to drink up completely; to drink the last of
definitions.explanation: To drink something until none is left. The compound suffix {尽|つ}くす adds the sense of doing the action completely, to exhaustion or until nothing remains.

examples.japanese: ⟦ビール→ビール：01015_biiru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{飲|の}み{尽|つ}くした。
examples.english: We drank up all the beer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}ら→彼ら：01802_karera⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ワイン→ワイン：01067_wain⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{飲|の}み{尽|つ}くした。
examples.english: They drank the bar's wine dry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祝|いわ}い→祝い：01838_iwai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{用意|ようい}した→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧⟦{酒|さけ}→酒：02211_sake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{飲|の}み{尽|つ}くした。
examples.english: At the celebration, everyone drank up all the sake that had been prepared.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
- Transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧): X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{飲|の}み{尽|つ}くす.

Compound of ⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧ (to drink) + ⟦{尽|つ}くす→尽くす：02077_tsukusu⟧ (to do exhaustively, use up).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{酒|さけ}→酒：02211_sake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{飲|の}み{尽|つ}くす: to drink up all the alcohol
- ⟦{一滴|いってき}→一滴：08893_itteki⟧⟦{残|のこ}ら→残る：01187_nokoru⟧ず{飲|の}み{尽|つ}くす: to drink up to the last drop

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{飲|の}み{干|ほ}す→飲み干す：21473_nomihosu⟧: to drink down; to drain — emptying a single container in one go, often a glass
- ⟦{使|つか}い{尽|つ}くす→使い尽くす：27813_tsukaitsukusu⟧: to use up completely — the same ⟦{尽|つ}くす→尽くす：02077_tsukusu⟧ pattern with a different base verb
